name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: A lightweight, cross-platform Tauri desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness—using the system WebView instead of bundling Chromium, with the complete Harness runtime included.

scripts.build:frontend: pnpm run harness:prepare && tsc && vite build
scripts.check: pnpm run harness:verify-source && pnpm run plugin:test && tsc --noEmit && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.plugin:test: pnpm run plugin:build && node --test desktop-plugins/*/test/*.test.mjs plugins/*/test/*.test.mjs
